name: Catch a Plane!
desc:
✈️ MY FRIEND MISSED HIS FLIGHT... SO WE MADE THIS GAME.

My friend overslept and missed his flight, so I thought: what if he actually tried to sprint down the runway and catch it? Hehehe.
(DO NOT TRY THIS IN REAL LIFE!)

Jump, grab a passing plane, and hang on for dear life as it drags you across the sky! Train your grip, upgrade your gear!

💪 TRAIN your strength to hold on longer

🧤 UPGRADE gloves to grab faster & heavier planes

🎁 OPEN GEAR BOXES for jetpacks, parachutes, and Gravity Wings

🏆 REACH THE FINISH to earn trophies and unlock new worlds

llm.loop: sprint down the runway -> grab a passing plane and hold on -> train grip/strength and upgrade gloves -> hold longer and reach the finish -> rebirth and unlock new worlds
llm.objectives: hang on long enough to reach the finish and unlock new worlds
llm.progression: strength, glove tiers, gear boxes, trophies, worlds, rebirths
llm.instructions: jump and grab a plane, train strength, upgrade gloves, open gear boxes, reach the finish
unique: hanging onto a flying plane as the core challenge
llm.thumbnails: character clinging to a plane, level 1 vs 60 comparison, text 'GRIP IT!', 'DON'T LET GO', update in 2 hours icon
llm.complexity_notes: runway plus plane paths, grip stamina, upgrade UI
